claim_limit: This case is explanatory and was selected without tracker outputs; it is not a qualitative performance ranking.

comparison_contract.box_and_mask_methods_receive: 48x48 original-pixel bbox centered on the same seed center
comparison_contract.sequence_order: All 701 frames in chronological order, one forward pass from frame 0; no frame skipping, correction or reinitialization.

crop.intensity_encoding: Lossless uint8 crop from the raw TIFF; no background subtraction or contrast transformation.

intended_use: Reader-facing explanation of heterogeneous proposal representations and their reduction to one common Gaussian measurement contract.

native_geometry_archive_gap.available: Reduced bbox center for OSTrack and reduced mask centroid for DAM4SAM.
native_geometry_archive_gap.not_available: The tracked bbox width/height and the native mask pixels for this frame were not retained by the publication runner.
native_geometry_archive_gap.rendering_constraint: Do not draw an empirical OSTrack bbox or DAM4SAM mask from these archived files. Either perform a targeted native-geometry export or label those glyphs as schematic.

selection.rule: Use the predeclared diagnostic probe whose selection_reason is 'evaluation_range_end', then use the lowest canonical core spot ID. Do not inspect tracker outputs when choosing the case.
